name: Feature Request
about: Suggest an idea or new capability for the JobHunt pipeline
title: '[FEAT]: '
labels: 'enhancement'
assignees: ''
---

## 🚀 Feature Description
A clear and concise description of the feature or capability you are proposing.

## 💡 Motivation & Problem Statement
Is your feature request related to a problem or limitation? (e.g., "I'm always frustrated when...")

## 🛠️ Proposed Solution & Architecture
Describe how this feature would be implemented:
- Which layer does it touch? (Layer 1 Ingestion, Layer 2 Dedup, Layer 3 Rerank/Score, Layer 4 Router, Layer 5 Sender)
- Does it require Bedrock tokens or can it be resolved deterministically?
- How is token economics preserved?

## 📊 Evaluation & Verification Plan
How will this feature be quantitatively verified in `evals/` or mocked unit tests?
